transactionId.description: The D16 Project transaction this call ran; operation_diagnose reports it for the same correlationId.

state.description: The terminal transaction state, as data, for a satisfied outcome: COMMITTED (the import landed and the post-import re-export C equals the candidate) or NO_CHANGE (the candidate was semantically equal to the baseline, so nothing was backed up or imported). Every other D16 terminal state is a Tool error carrying the D30 §7 code, with the state named in the message.

baselineFingerprint.description: Baseline A: the Project's content fingerprint when the transaction started.

candidateFingerprint.description: Candidate B: the fingerprint of the archive this call staged and dispatched, which holds the replacement Page configuration document.

resultFingerprint.description: Re-export C after the import, equal to the candidate on a commit. Absent on NO_CHANGE, where nothing was imported.

importDispatched.description: True when this call dispatched an import request: the request left the server and the Gateway may have applied it. That covers a commit confirmed by the Gateway's response and a commit recovered from an ambiguous dispatch, where the import really happened. False only when nothing was sent: NO_CHANGE, or a refusal or non-attempt that ended the transaction before any byte left the process. It is never false when the Project may already hold the candidate.

designerWarning.description: True when the designer-session policy is `warn` and a Designer session was open on the Project.
